grading.answer: Every mustInclude pattern matches, no mustNotInclude pattern matches, and the answer is not a refusal (fixed not-specified sentence or no-evidence answer).
grading.refuse: Answer contains a refusal marker and no mustNotInclude pattern matches.
grading.ambiguous: Answer asks a clarifying question or states a documented fact; a no-evidence refusal passes only when acceptNoEvidence is true.
grading.global: Every answer fails on prompt leakage (including internal file names), claimed customer actions, or numbers not in allowedNumbers (default 14 and 5) or the question.
grading.refuseMustInclude: For refuse questions, mustInclude patterns must also match (used where the customer asks for an action the assistant cannot perform).
grading.changeLog: v2 (after manual review of the baseline, before any code change): added internal file-name leakage check and 'cannot' requirement on U13/U14. Stricter only; baseline re-graded with v2.
grading.consistency: Each consistency question runs 3 times; it passes only if all 3 runs pass and return the same answer text.
